knitr::opts_chunk$set(

```{r load-packages, include=FALSE}
# Load packages for data manipulation, file paths, dates, and table creation
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
library(lubridate)
```


```{r import-data, include=FALSE}
# Import patient-level and encounter-level datasets using project-relative paths
patient <- read_csv(here("Data", "PatientData-2.csv"))
encounter <- read_csv(here("Data", "EncounterData-2.csv"))
```


```{r explore-data, include=FALSE}
# Examine dataset dimensions, variable names, and data types
dim(patient)
dim(encounter)

names(patient)
names(encounter)

glimpse(patient)
glimpse(encounter)

# Check missing values and identify potentially implausible values
colSums(is.na(patient))
colSums(is.na(encounter))

summary(encounter)

sum(encounter$BMI < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(encounter$WBC < 1, na.rm = TRUE)

# Confirm MRN can be used as the patient identifier for merging
n_distinct(patient$MRN)
n_distinct(encounter$MRN)

patient |>
  count(MRN) |>
  filter(n > 1)
```


```{r merge-data, include=FALSE}
# Add patient-level characteristics to each encounter using MRN
analytic <- encounter |>
  left_join(patient, by = "MRN")
```

## Analytic Dataset  
The analytic dataset contains 550 rows and 14 variables. Each row represents one patient encounter. The dataset combines encounter-level information, including encounter type, temperature, distress score, WBC, and BMI, with patient-level demographic and clinical characteristics, including race, ethnicity, financial class, hypertension, CHF, and diabetes.  

&nbsp;

## Data Cleaning  
The patient-level dataset contained no missing values. In the encounter-level dataset, 53 distress scores and 86 BMI values were missing. Six additional BMI values were negative and therefore considered implausible; these values were recoded as missing. Dates were converted from character strings to date variables. Fourteen WBC values were below the limit of detection and were set to 1 as specified in the project instructions.

```{r clean-data, include=FALSE}
# Convert date variables from character strings to date format
analytic <- analytic |>
  mutate(
    DOB = mdy(DOB),
    contact_date = mdy(contact_date)
  )

glimpse(analytic)

# Recode negative BMI values as missing because they are implausible
analytic <- analytic |>
  mutate(
    BMI = if_else(BMI < 0, NA_real_, BMI)
  )

summary(analytic$BMI)

# Replace WBC values below the limit of detection (<1) with 1
analytic <- analytic |>
  mutate(
    WBC = if_else(WBC < 1, 1, WBC)
  )

summary(analytic$WBC)
sum(analytic$WBC < 1, na.rm = TRUE)

# Categorize WBC according to the project-specified cut points
analytic <- analytic |>
  mutate(
    WBC_group = case_when(
      is.na(WBC) ~ "Not Taken",
      WBC < 3.2 ~ "Low",
      WBC <= 9.8 ~ "Normal",
      WBC > 9.8 ~ "High"
    )
  )

table(analytic$WBC_group, useNA = "ifany")

# Set WBC categories in a logical order for reporting
analytic <- analytic |>
  mutate(
    WBC_group = factor(
      WBC_group,
      levels = c("Low", "Normal", "High", "Not Taken")
    )
  )

table(analytic$WBC_group)
```

&nbsp;

## WBC Summary Table  
WBC was categorized as Low (<3.2), Normal (3.2–9.8), High (>9.8), or Not Taken. The table below summarizes the distribution of WBC categories across encounters.

```{r wbc-table}
# Calculate encounter counts and percentages for each WBC category
wbc_table <- analytic |>
  count(WBC_group, .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    percent = paste0(round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1), "%")
  )

# Format the WBC summary table for presentation
wbc_table |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    WBC_group = "WBC Group",
    n = "Count",
    percent = "Percent"
  )
```
&nbsp;

## Patient Characteristics  
Table 1 summarizes demographic and clinical characteristics for the 50 unique patients in the patient-level dataset. Counts and percentages are presented for race, ethnicity, financial class, hypertension, congestive heart failure, and diabetes.


```{r table-one}
# Recode clinical variables with readable labels for Table 1
patient |>
  mutate(
    ethnicity = recode(
      ethnicity,
      "non-Hispanic" = "Non-Hispanic"
    ),
    hypertension = recode(
      hypertension,
      "N" = "No",
      "Y" = "Yes"
    ),
    CHF = recode(
      CHF,
      "N" = "No",
      "Y" = "Yes"
    ),
    diabetes = recode(
      diabetes,
      "N" = "No",
      "Y" = "Yes"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    race,
    ethnicity,
    financialclass,
    hypertension,
    CHF,
    diabetes
  ) |>
  tbl_summary(
    type = all_categorical() ~ "categorical",
    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    label = list(
      race ~ "Race",
      ethnicity ~ "Ethnicity",
      financialclass ~ "Financial Class",
      hypertension ~ "Hypertension",
      CHF ~ "Congestive Heart Failure",
      diabetes ~ "Diabetes"
    )
  )
```
